name: tradingview-mcp
description: AI-assisted TradingView chart analysis — connect Claude Code to your TradingView Desktop for personal workflow automation
one_liner: A bridge that lets an AI assistant look at your own TradingView charts and help write trading scripts, running entirely on your own computer with your own paid subscription.
buyer: An active retail trader who already pays for TradingView and wants AI help writing custom indicators and reading their own charts, without sending trade data anywhere.
business_use_cases: An individual trader automates repetitive Pine Script indicator tweaks that used to take an afternoon of manual scripting.
A trading educator builds AI-assisted chart-analysis tutorials for students who already use TradingView.
A freelance quant offers custom Pine Script development services to retail traders, using the AI bridge to work faster.

money_ideas.idea: Sell custom Pine Script indicator development for retail traders, delivered faster using the AI bridge
Package a paid tutorial course on AI-assisted chart analysis for existing TradingView subscribers

steal_this: This weekend, build and sell three or four popular custom indicators built with AI assistance, since it's this project's whole reason for existing.
